meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback (especially if unclear or technically questionable), when completing tasks or major features requiring review before proceeding, or before making any completion/success claims. Covers three practices - receiving feedback with technical rigor over performative agreement, requesting reviews via code-reviewer subagent, and verification gates requiring evidence before any status claims. Essential for subagent-driven development, pull requests, and preventing false completion claims.

copy.tagline: 审查代码反馈并确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理代码审查反馈或确保代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Review code feedback and ensure quality standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle code review feedback or need to ensure code quality

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会严格遵循代码审查流程：收到反馈时先理解再验证，不盲目同意；完成任务后自动请求子代理审查；在声称任何完成状态前，必须提供最新验证证据。
howto.when: 当收到代码审查反馈（尤其不清晰或可疑时）、完成任务或主要功能后、或声称任何完成/成功状态前触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段代码，指出问题。
say.note: 触发子代理进行代码审查。

say.text: 检查测试是否全部通过。
say.note: 触发验证门，要求提供测试通过证据。

say.text: 这个反馈我不太理解，请澄清。
say.note: 触发接收反馈协议，要求先澄清。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will strictly follow code review practices: when receiving feedback, it will understand and verify before agreeing; after completing tasks, it will automatically request review via subagent; before any completion claims, it must provide fresh verification evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when receiving code review feedback (especially if unclear or questionable), after completing tasks or major features, or before making any completion/success claims.

say_en.text: Review this code and point out issues.

say_en.note: Triggers verification gate requiring test evidence.

say_en.text: I don't understand this feedback, please clarify.
say_en.note: Triggers receiving feedback protocol to ask for clarification.
